experiments.scope: The line of proof Section 1 with two S-box layers after it (rounds 2 and 3 of the target permutation; degree 25, m = 12); one uniform centre for each organizer seed of trial index 0 mod 3 (the other trials are reported as skipped; parts a, b, c together cover every trial).
experiments.hypothesis: Premise H-ONE at two layers: the fraction of centres with 1 <= k(c) <= 16 is close to the hyperoctahedral value 0.39347; premise H-NORMAL at two layers: the remainder sequence of (g_c, Y - 1) is normal (observation normal = 1). Both are reported per trial as observations; no message pair is returned, so the organizer success count is 0 by design.
